description: TY2026: the OBBBA QSBS tiers — stock acquired after July 4, 2025 and held 4 whole years excludes 75% of the gain (SS 1202(a), $15M cap not binding): 75% x 2,000,000 = $1,500,000 excluded. The taxed remainder is SS 1(h)(4) 28%-rate gain — deliberately NOT representable in the individual chain (disclosed).
